notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where players would get Softlocked if the free microchip was crafted while the inventory was full 

Fixed a bug where players couldn't have access to any of the globes if the microchip was crafted while the inventory was full 

Fixed a bug where players could eat shells from the inventory
